```plato
//==
// # Statistics
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Statistics
//  - Covariance, correlation, and fits

//==
// # Statistics
//
// Univariate descriptive statistics: summaries, histograms, quantiles, and
// the smoothing and outlier rules applied to a single sample
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Descriptive_statistics). Conventions: sample
// statistics use Bessel's correction (divide by n - 1); kurtosis is excess
// kurtosis (a normal distribution scores 0). The bivariate surface --
// covariance, correlation, and fits -- follows in the next section.

// Descriptive statistics of a univariate sample. Variance and StandardDeviation
// use the sample (n - 1) convention; Skewness and Kurtosis are standardized
// moments, with Kurtosis reported as excess (normal = 0).
type SummaryStatistics
    implements IValue
{
    Count: Integer;
    Sum: Number;
    Mean: Number;
    Variance: Number;
    StandardDeviation: Number;
    Minimum: Number;
    Maximum: Number;
    Skewness: Number;
    Kurtosis: Number;
}
```
